change: Diagnostic-only Fair WakeeSelected reschedule Lazy -> Immediate
restored_source_rebuild_diff_scope: Only .kallsyms differs: both bins are 17465344 bytes; cmp passes before binary offset 0x842000 and from 0x1042000 to EOF. Both ELF section tables place .kallsyms at file offset 0x852000 with size 0x800000; the binary drops the first 0x10000 bytes. Exact image-byte reproducibility remains unproven, but all non-kallsyms binary bytes match.
effect: B1 and B2 each passed the full20 sample gate, but only 10/20 candidate rows meet the Linux RT 90% p50 threshold and the worst is 32.043%. A2 is invalid. Both historical A and candidate B build logs identify the same isolated root-exporter worktree as Workspace root; the differing Cargo target directory is not a source difference. The valid A1-to-B1/B2 comparison gives an exploratory 2.688% same-CPU futex p50 reduction. Several p99/p999 rows increase by at least 3% in this single-valid-A screening comparison; A2 invalidity prevents a formal two-boot regression-gate decision. Rebuilding after source restoration yielded a different whole-image SHA only because .kallsyms bytes differ; all other binary bytes match. The historical A image remains the only measured ordinary control and exact whole-image byte reproducibility is unproven.
decision: Reject Fair Lazy -> Immediate. It is far short of the 90% goal and has possible tail regressions. Restore only the one-line trial, preserving the pre-existing exporter patch. No production or PR logic change is retained.
